verdict.rationale: Supabase documents branching that creates separate environments, including isolated preview environments per pull request, for testing schema, config and feature changes without affecting production. A local CLI stack (`supabase init` / `supabase start`) adds an offline sandbox, and a runtime probe confirms the CLI runs without an account. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that branches isolate production data, and evidence that AI agents or the MCP server can be scoped specifically to a branch or local sandbox.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: You can use these branching environments to create and test changes like new configurations, database schemas, or features without affecting your production setup.
Branching takes this further, adding isolated preview environments for each pull request.
Develop locally using the CLI to run a local Supabase stack
